// Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

/**
 * Data models for the Recursion API (spec version 1.0.0).
 */
import type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue } from '../core/json.js';

export type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue };

/**
 * Mutual recursion: a folder holds entries, an entry holds folders.
 */
export interface Folder {
  name: string;
  leaves?: Leaf[];
}

/**
 * The other half of the cycle.
 */
export interface Leaf {
  title: string;
  folders?: Folder[];
}

/**
 * A node that holds a list of itself — direct recursion.
 */
export interface Tree {
  label: string;
  children?: Tree[];
}
